SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT PLANT , LEGACY_GR_NO , LEGACY_GR_SEQ , LEGACY_PO_NO , LEGACY_PO_SEQ FROM TBL_KEP_GR WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY PLANT,LEGACY_GR_NO,LEGACY_GR_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'CTLCD' AS BUYER , 'KA' AS SITE , '1' AS REVISION , PLANT , LEGACY_PO_NO , LEGACY_PO_SEQ , LEGACY_GR_NO , LEGACY_GR_SEQ , STATUS , BUYER_ITEM_NO , CURRENCY_CODE , UNIT_PRICE , GR_QTY , GR_AMT , GR_DATE FROM TBL_KEP_GR WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ= '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND LEGACY_GR_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND LEGACY_GR_SEQ= '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
UPDATE TBL_KEP_GR SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = convert(varchar,getdate(),112) WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ= '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND LEGACY_GR_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND LEGACY_GR_SEQ= '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$'
